=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:135-147 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A markdown sub-heading inside `## De-scoped phases` stops the scan before later list items, so valid de-scope content is missed.
  WHY: The loop breaks on any `SECTION_HEADING_RE` match, including `###`-`######`, so the lint returns False on well-formed sections with sub-headings.
- .github/workflows/integration-pr-readiness.yml:70-77 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The workflow passes PR-controlled head ref and SHA into the readiness check invocation in a way reviewers flagged as shell-injection-prone.
  WHY: Both reviewers said a crafted branch name can be interpolated into the inline shell command and influence the runner invocation.
- scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:128-146
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `--head-ref` is accepted without sanitizing or validating that it matches a safe `orchestrator/project-<N>` branch-name pattern.
  WHY: A malformed ref can flow into later display/status logic and create injection risk.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3407-3415 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: When the 3-way merge path fails on `cp` or `git add`, `refreshed_list` and `refreshed_count` can still report the file as refreshed.
  WHY: The counters are only updated in the success branch, so the refresh summary can overstate staged changes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8619-8627 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Concurrent poller runs can read a stale `external_finalize_partial_alert_sig` and both decide to send the same alert.
  WHY: The read is not atomic with the later write, so overlapping cron ticks can duplicate the at-most-once Telegram alert.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8607-8612 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_extfin_incomplete_json` only treats `.status == "not_created"` as incomplete, so other non-terminal statuses are ignored.
  WHY: An externally merged integration PR can be marked complete while sub-issues are in failed or review-blocked state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3407-3420 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: If `git add` fails in the 3-way merge path and `git checkout --` also fails, the revert is silently swallowed and the worktree can remain dirty.
  WHY: `|| true` hides the revert failure, leaving a partially-staged state that does not match the commit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3387-3433 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The 3-way-merge temp directory is cleaned up with a bare `rm -rf` that is neither trapped nor checked.
  WHY: If cleanup fails, stale temp files can be left behind on the runner and pollute later refresh cycles.
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:76-199 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `AUTO_CLOSE_RE` still accepts the colon-form auto-close syntax.
  WHY: Quoted text like `Closes: #2734` can falsely trigger the lint even though GitHub does not auto-close on that form.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3839-3892 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight and create-PR steps now use a different step name and additional `title.txt`/`lint-input.txt` files, breaking consumers that depended on the old single-file contract.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that keys off the exact log step name or previous artifact layout can silently skip or mis-handle the workflow output.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
